title: WITHOUT corporation
author: MAXFOG (from Without corp.)
description:
RE: Climbing Up the Walls

We interrupt your selection of this year’s IFComp entries to introduce an assignment. WITHOUT corporation requires simple monitoring of this year's game.

Reports show only Frotz, Gargoyle, or the online legacy terminal below are suitable interpreters to access the file. Alternatives are strictly forbidden. Please note the online legacy terminal (accessed at 'Play Online') has neither scrollback features nor screenreader capabilities. Please proceed at your own risk.

CONTENT WARNINGS: Mild body horror, gaslighting, swearing, and death. Fast flashing light sequences can be skipped by typing COLOR at the first available prompt. But don't fret - you’ll be fine.

Not that you have a choice. We’re the only ones that keep you alive.

We hope you have a great time working with us, as always!
